## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to diagnose cross-system data integrity issues in a CNPA ETL path and design robust fixes.

## Key Concepts

- End-to-end data integrity across HTTP, Postgres, Kafka, and Elasticsearch
- Exactly-once vs at-least-once guarantees and idempotent sinks
- CDC latency, replication lag, and sink backpressure

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo idempotent sink for Elasticsearch
async function upsertElasticsearch(event) {
  await es.update({
    index: 'events',
    id: event.id,
    doc: event,
    doc_as_upsert: true
  });
}
```
